  path={"/capability-offers"}

</MethodEndpoint>



The figure this context would tell the network it can ship for each (SKU, site) it knows about: `min(physicalAvailable, throughputFeasibleBefore(nextCutoff))` (ADR 0001 §8). Offers are persisted by the recompute loop. In live mode `FeedInventory` submits them to the network as a per-site inventory feed (ADR 0027 part 2); in stub mode nothing is sent.

Always registered: the capability-offer recompute loop and its Kafka-fed caches are part of the runtime (ADR 0025).

Keyset-paginated (fleet REST guideline section 3): ordered by (`sku`, `siteId`). Follow `nextCursor` until it is absent. Any query parameter other than `limit` and `cursor` is a 400 `unknown-query-parameter`.
